nodes.description: State variable owner: current owner address of the Owned contract
State variable newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership
State variable balances: token balance mapping(address => uint)
State variable allowed: allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint))
State variable tokensMinted: total tokens minted so far
State variable miningTarget: current PoW difficulty target
State variable challengeNumber: current blockhash based PoW challenge
State variable rewardEra: current halving era index
State variable maxSupplyForEra: minting cap for the current era
State variable _totalSupply: fixed maximum token supply
State variable decimals: token decimals (8)
State variable locked: constructor re-entrancy guard flag
State variable solutionForChallenge: mapping(bytes32 => bytes32) recording submitted solutions
State variable lastRewardTo: address of the last rewarded miner
State variable epochCount: number of mined epochs
State variable _BLOCKS_PER_READJUSTMENT: epochs between difficulty readjustments
State variable _MINIMUM_TARGET: hardest permitted mining target
State variable _MAXIMUM_TARGET: easiest permitted mining target and initial target
State variable latestDifficultyPeriodStarted: block number when last difficulty period started
Function mint: Proof-of-Work based token minting entry point
Function _startNewMiningEpoch: advances era, epoch count and challenge number
Function _reAdjustDifficulty: adjusts miningTarget by up to 50 percent using block numbers
Function transfer: ERC20 transfer from msg.sender
Function transferFrom: ERC20 transferFrom debiting the allowance
Function approve: ERC20 approve setting the allowance
Function approveAndCall: sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender
Function transferAnyERC20Token: owner-only sweep of arbitrary ERC20 tokens
Function transferOwnership: owner-only first step of two-step ownership transfer
Function acceptOwnership: newOwner confirms the ownership transfer
Function Owned: constructor assigning owner = msg.sender
Function _HachirokuToken: constructor initializing supply, target and first epoch
Function getMiningReward: returns the reward for the current era
Function checkMintSolution: view helper validating a candidate PoW solution
Function getMintDigest: view helper returning the PoW digest
Function fallback: payable fallback that always reverts
Function totalSupply: returns supply minus balances held at address(0)
Function balanceOf: returns the token balance of an address
Function allowance: returns the remaining allowance
Function getChallengeNumber: returns the current challenge number
Function getMiningDifficulty: returns _MAXIMUM_TARGET divided by miningTarget
Untrusted input msg.sender: externally controlled caller address
Unsafe operation: external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data)
Unsafe operation: external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary address
Unsafe operation: chained mul/div/sub/add arithmetic on miningTarget and reward derived from block numbers
Parameter nonce of mint(uint256 nonce, bytes32 challenge_digest)
Parameter challenge_digest of mint(uint256 nonce, bytes32 challenge_digest)
Local variable digest in mint(): keccak256(challengeNumber, msg.sender, nonce)
Local variable reward_amount in mint(): result of getMiningReward()
Local variable solution in mint(): previous solutionForChallenge value
Parameter to of transfer(address to, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens of transfer(address to, uint tokens)
Parameter from of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter to of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens)
Parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens of approve(address spender, uint tokens)
Parameter spender of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data)
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data)
Parameter data of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data)
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens)
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens)
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership(address _newOwner)
Parameter nonce of checkMintSolution(uint256 nonce, bytes32 challenge_digest, bytes32 challenge_number, uint testTarget)
Parameter challenge_digest of checkMintSolution(...)
Parameter challenge_number of checkMintSolution(...)
Parameter testTarget of checkMintSolution(...)
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf(address tokenOwner)
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender)
Parameter spender of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender)

Local reward_amount is a temporary value used only to credit mint()
Local solution is a temporary read used only for replay protection inside mint()
